mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.customer_name AS customerName, o.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, o.quantity AS quantity, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.order_date AS orderDate, o.delivery_date AS deliveryDate, o.delete_flg AS deleteFlg FROM t_order o INNER JOIN m_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.delete_flg = 0 ORDER BY o.order_id DESC

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.customer_name AS customerName, o.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, o.quantity AS quantity, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.order_date AS orderDate, o.delivery_date AS deliveryDate, o.delete_flg AS deleteFlg FROM t_order o INNER JOIN m_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.delete_flg = 0
SELECT product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName FROM m_product WHERE delete_flg = 0 AND is_active = true ORDER BY product_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order ( order_no, customer_name, product_id, quantity, order_status, order_date, delivery_date, delete_flg ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{customerName}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{orderStatus}, #{orderDate}, #{deliveryDate}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET order_no = #{orderNo}, customer_name = #{customerName}, product_id = #{productId}, quantity = #{quantity}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, order_date = #{orderDate}, delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND delete_flg = 0
UPDATE t_order SET delete_flg = 1 WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND delete_flg = 0
